resources.string: Ayikho imonitha eseduze. Amamonitha athumela isignali isikhashana ngemva kokukala noma kumodi ye-Bluetooth kuphela.
Okunye ukungenisa akuphelanga. Ukufundwa okutholiwe kulondoloziwe; donsela phansi ukuze uzame futhi.
Qedela isenzo samanje semonitha, bese udonsela phansi futhi.
Qala ngokubhanqa noma uxhume imonitha esekelwayo.
Ayikwazanga ukusesha amamonitha. Hlola i-Bluetooth, bese udonsela phansi futhi.
